Number-Conversion Macros / Format Conversions

FractToFixed

You can use the FractToFixed macro to convert a fract number to a Fixed number. 
#define FractToFixed (a) ((Fixed) (a) + 8192L >> 14)
a
A fract number to be converted to a Fixed number.
macro result
A Fixed number having the closest value to the fract number.
